decisions.reason: The accelerator program lies outside the firm's machinery knowledge, so weak absorptive capacity makes it hard to interpret and improve, leading to likely drop.
The bio-based binder requires materials and chemistry knowledge that only partly overlaps with the firm's waste-machinery expertise, so limited absorptive capacity increases drop risk.
This decontamination plant builds directly on the firm's waste-treatment machinery and cooperation with ERMAFA, giving strong absorptive capacity to learn and improve.
The mobile recycling plant is a core extension of the firm's existing waste machinery, so high absorptive capacity supports keeping it.
